entries.text: 如果和上次一样，\n说不定这次也……[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_01

entries.text: 真的在这里！\n绝对没错，这就是调味料！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_03

entries.text: 嗯～让我看看？\n书上是这么说的……[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_05

entries.text:
据说[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]秘传：甜味料[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]
有健胃消食的功效！\c
而且对腹痛和食欲不振
也效果绝佳！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_a

entries.text:
据说[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]秘传：咸味料[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]
有缓解手脚疼痛和麻木的功效！\c
并且对改善肌肉力量下降
也有效果！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_b

entries.text:
据说[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]秘传：苦味料[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]
有促进血液循环的功效！\c
可以让身体变得暖洋洋，
并且提高免疫力！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_c

entries.text:
据说[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]秘传：酸味料[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]滋身健体！
其中含有丰富的营养！\c
对疲惫的身心非～常有效，
眨眼间就能恢复活力！！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_d

entries.text:
据说[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]秘传：辣味料[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]能促进新陈代谢！
对改善循环机能也卓有成效。\c
随着大量出汗，
毒素也会一起排出体外！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_e

entries.text: 如果能把这东西\n烹饪好以后给它吃……！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_06

entries.text: 好嘞，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]！\n该吃饭了，吃饭！\r\n我马上准备好！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_07

entries.text: 喔噢噢噢噢噢噢！\n哼啊！哈啊！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_29

entries.text: 久等了！\c\n这是本人特制的\n调味料满满随心三明治！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_08

entries.text: 还有代表我感谢之情的\n宝主徽章也送给你……喏！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_09

entries.text: 啊嘎嘶！
entries.label: legend_0030_legend_01

entries.text: ……真是的，怎么又来了啊！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_10

entries.text: 嗅嗅……
entries.label: legend_0030_legend_02

entries.text: 要把三明治\n给[VAR 0x0101(0001)]吗？
entries.label: legend_0030_system_02

entries.text: 给它！
entries.label: legend_0030_select_01

entries.text: 不给
entries.label: legend_0030_select_02

entries.text: 咕啾……
entries.label: legend_0030_legend_03

entries.text: 还是把三明治\n给[VAR 0x0101(0001)]如何？
entries.label: legend_0030_system_03

entries.text: 嘎啊嘶。
entries.label: legend_0030_legend_04

entries.text: 哼～它是在表达感谢吗……？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_11

entries.text: 预先多做了一些，\n真是太正确了。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_12

entries.text: 这可都是为了犒劳努力帮忙的\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你才做的。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_13

entries.text: 吧唧吧唧……！
entries.label: legend_0030_legend_05

entries.text: 啊嘎～嘶！
entries.label: legend_0030_legend_06

entries.text: [VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n学会了坐骑招式：冲刺！
entries.label: legend_0030_system_04

entries.text: [VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n学会了坐骑招式：高跳！
entries.label: legend_0030_system_05

entries.text: [VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n学会了坐骑招式：滑翔！
entries.label: legend_0030_system_06

entries.text: [VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n学会了坐骑招式：冲浪！
entries.label: legend_0030_system_07

entries.text: [VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n学会了坐骑招式：攀崖！
entries.label: legend_0030_system_08

entries.text: 总觉得它又成长了？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_15

entries.text: 啊嘎！
entries.label: legend_0030_legend_07

entries.text: 果然秘传调味料\n效力非凡～[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_16

entries.text: ……不然的话，\n我可就伤脑筋了。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_17

entries.text: 嗅嗅……！
entries.label: legend_0030_legend_08

entries.text: 啊嘎？
entries.label: legend_0030_legend_09

entries.text: 那不是给你的！！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_19

entries.text: 啊嘎……？
entries.label: legend_0030_legend_10

entries.text: 啊……抱歉。\n我不该这么大声。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_20

entries.text: 我该好好跟[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你\n说明一下才对。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_21

entries.text: 这家伙是獒教父，\n我的搭档。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_23

entries.text: 啊……嘎啊。
entries.label: legend_0030_legend_11

entries.text: 来，吃点能让你\n恢复精神的三明治吧。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_24

entries.text: 一点一点地吃就好，\n要慢慢地、慢慢地嚼哦。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_26

entries.text: 这家伙不久之前……\n受了重伤。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_27

entries.text: 在那之后，\n就一直身体不好……[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_28

entries.text: 伤药呢？
entries.label: legend_0030_select_03

entries.text: 宝可梦中心呢？
entries.label: legend_0030_select_04

entries.text: 伤药也好，宝可梦中心也罢，\n都无法治好它。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_29a

entries.text: 他们说这不是\n普通的伤或者疾病。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_29b

entries.text: ……对我来说，\n獒教父这家伙是我的唯一。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_30

entries.text: 不论用什么方法，\n我绝对要治好它。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_31

entries.text: 我在网上和书本里\n查找了许多治疗方法，\r\n几乎尝试了一个遍。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_32

entries.text: 可不论哪种方法都不太见效。\n正当我快要放弃的时候……[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_33

entries.text: 我终于寻觅到了\n秘传调味料这一存在！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_34

entries.text: 那本书是？
entries.label: legend_0030_select_05

entries.text: 你调查得真用心
entries.label: legend_0030_select_06

entries.text: 这是我在我妈的\n研究室里找到的。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_35a

entries.text: 这是我在我爸的\n研究室里找到的。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_35b

entries.text: 我在我妈的研究室里\n找到了这本书。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_36a

entries.text: 我在我爸的研究室里\n找到了这本书。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_37b

entries.text: 里面的内容似乎全是胡说八道，\n就是本没人会相信的超自然读物而已。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_38

entries.text: 可是，我相信\n里面说的是真的！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_39

entries.text: 这本书上说，\n只要吃下全部５种秘传调味料，\r\n不论什么伤病都能治好！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_40

entries.text: 实际上，吃完上一种调味料后，\n獒教父曾经无比冰冷的手脚\r\n已经变得稍微温暖一些了。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_41

entries.text: 呜哇哇！獒教父！\n你这是……！\r\n眼睛能看见了吗！？[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_43

entries.text: 太好了！太好了！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_44

entries.text: 这么久了……它一直\n连眼睛也无法睁开！\r\n我担心死了……！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_45

entries.text: 呜呜……太好了！\n真的太好了……！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_46

entries.text: 哇……哈哈，哈哈哈……！\n它溜圆的眼睛太小了，\r\n都要看不出来到底有没有睁开了～！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_47

entries.text: 调味料的力量好厉害！\n果然是真材实料！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_48

entries.text: 我绝对要让獒教父\n恢复成像以前一样\r\n充满活力的样子。[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_49

entries.text: ……事情就是这样，所以说呢～[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0030_friend_50

entries.text: 还剩下３种调味料没有找到，\n一起加油吧！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
